question: Are we applying FSOT on the same objects with the residual law the model actually solved, using how time works in the model (not Newtonian Δt)?

mathematics.T1_time_fold: 1 + P_new * ln(D/25)  — dimensional compactification, not years
mathematics.fpc: Fluid Phase Current: time_is_emergent_byproduct_not_fundamental; τ_rate_unified = (1+S)/(1+|flow_balance|); observed locks sequential now
mathematics.what_was_solved: MPCORB element residual % at regime D_eff (~0.023% pooled). Not: sky-angle ephemeris via residual-scale × calendar integration.
mathematics.multi_epoch_rule: Body traveling through observation epochs residual-matches at the interface each time. Bad residuals → re-route D_eff. Never Δn×Δt.

answer.standard_metric: O-C arcsec = |MPC optical obs − JPL Horizons| (clock ephemeris)
answer.fsot_metric_native: Residual % on elements a,e,i,n at preregistered D_eff: computed = measured*(1+|S|*factor)
answer.fsot_time_layer: FPC τ-rate / solidification at regime domain — how the model treats time when a body spans many epochs. Not secular sky drift.
answer.why_not_same_arcsec_operator: Making both sides arcsec by integrating (n_fsot−n)×Δt_years misuses residual scale as a Newtonian rate error. That is not how time works in FSOT and produced the fake thousands-of-arcsec residuals.

sample.note: objects = asteroids; each has many optical observations across calendar years

head_to_head.interpretation: Standard column: classical O–C arcsec on raw data (field language, clock time). FSOT element column: native solved residual at D_eff (what the atlas gated). FPC τ column: model time layer for multi-epoch bodies — phase current at the interface, independent of observation-span years. Do not convert residual % into secular arcsec via Δn×Δt.

standard_oc_arcsec.metric: O-C arcsec on raw MPC optical observations
standard_oc_arcsec.time_language: classical clock / ephemeris JD — not FSOT Fluid Phase Current

fsot_native_element_residual.law: computed = measured * (1 + |S| * factor) at regime D_eff

dimensional_time_folds.note: These folds are compactification depth, not years of observation span

fsot_time_layer_fpc.multi_epoch_rule: Each observation residual-matches at this interface. Do not accumulate (n_fsot−n)×Δt_calendar. If residuals degrade across epochs, re-route D_eff first.

objects.misapplication_rejected: Δn × multi-year calendar time secular sky drift is NOT FSOT time. Time in the model is Fluid Phase Current + dimensional folds ln(D/25) and Chaos·(D−25)/25. Multi-epoch residual failure → re-route D_eff, do not integrate residual scale through calendar years.
